title: Concept: Workspace allows every dependency to run install scripts
description: pnpm-workspace.yaml declares a pnpm workspace that does not restrict which dependencies may run build scripts, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A script that runs during install or build executes with the developer or CI identity, before any test or review has looked at the code. This rule reads a pnpm workspace that does not restrict which dependencies may run build scripts.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pnpm-workspace.yaml (npm).
risk: A script that runs during install or build executes with the developer or CI identity, before any test or review has looked at the code. This rule reads a pnpm workspace that does not restrict which dependencies may run build scripts.
